description: Nernst equilibrium: what midpoint the C17-C80 couple would need for the disulphide to form at the measured cytoplasmic potential
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, pandas as pd
R,T,F,z=8.3143,298.15,96485.3321,2
EGSH=-0.3144              # V, measured E. coli cytoplasm, Grx1-roGFP2, PMID 39689618
ZHAO=(-0.260,-0.200)      # V, range Zhao et al. 2022 assumed for "normal cytoplasm"

Eo=np.linspace(-0.420,-0.140,1200)          # hypothetical midpoint of the C17-C80 couple
def frac_ox(Eo,Eamb):
    # equilibrium with the ambient thiol-disulphide couple: E_prot = E_amb
    ln_red_over_ox=(Eo-Eamb)*z*F/(R*T)
    ratio=np.exp(np.clip(ln_red_over_ox,-700,700))
    return 1.0/(1.0+ratio)
fo_meas=frac_ox(Eo,EGSH)
fo_lo  =frac_ox(Eo,ZHAO[0])
fo_hi  =frac_ox(Eo,ZHAO[1])

def need(target,Eamb):          # midpoint required to reach `target` oxidised fraction
    return Eamb+(R*T/(z*F))*np.log(target/(1-target))
for tgt in [0.5,0.1,0.01]:
    print(f"to hold {tgt:>5.0%} of AcrIIC1 disulphide-linked, the C17-C80 midpoint must be "
          f"{1000*need(tgt,EGSH):7.1f} mV (vs measured E. coli cytoplasm) | "
          f"{1000*need(tgt,ZHAO[0]):7.1f} mV (vs -260) | {1000*need(tgt,ZHAO[1]):7.1f} mV (vs -200)")

# known protein thiol couples for calibration
known=[(-0.270,"E. coli Trx1 E°'"),(-0.233,"E. coli Grx1 E°'"),(-0.198,"E. coli DsbC"),
       (-0.122,"E. coli DsbA"),(-0.080,"Nm DsbA1/2/3 (PMID 19631659)")]

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,5.0))
a=ax[0]
a.plot(1000*Eo,100*fo_meas,lw=2.4,color="#2166ac",
       label="ambient = −314.4 mV (measured, E. coli cytoplasm, PMID 39689618)")
a.fill_between(1000*Eo,100*fo_lo,100*fo_hi,color="#999999",alpha=0.35,
       label="ambient = −260 to −200 mV (range assumed by Zhao et al. 2022)")
a.axhline(50,color="k",ls=":",lw=0.9)
for v,lab in known:
    a.axvline(1000*v,color="#bbbbbb",lw=0.8)
    a.text(1000*v,103,lab,rotation=90,fontsize=6.4,va="bottom",ha="center",color="#666666")
a.set_xlabel("hypothetical midpoint E°' of the AcrIIC1 C17–C80 couple (mV)")
a.set_ylabel("% of AcrIIC1 held as the disulphide-linked dimer at equilibrium")
a.set_xlim(-420,-140); a.set_ylim(0,100)
a.legend(fontsize=7.2,loc="center left")
a.set_title("A  What the unmeasured number would have to be",loc="left",fontsize=11)

b=ax[1]
tg=np.array([0.5,0.1,0.01,0.001])
xs=np.arange(len(tg))
b.bar(xs-0.2,1000*need(tg,EGSH),0.4,color="#2166ac",label="vs measured −314.4 mV")
b.bar(xs+0.2,1000*need(tg,ZHAO[0]),0.4,color="#999999",label="vs assumed −260 mV")
for x,t in zip(xs,tg):
    b.text(x-0.2,1000*need(t,EGSH)-6,f"{1000*need(t,EGSH):.0f}",ha="center",va="top",fontsize=7.5,color="white")
    b.text(x+0.2,1000*need(t,ZHAO[0])-6,f"{1000*need(t,ZHAO[0]):.0f}",ha="center",va="top",fontsize=7.5,color="white")
b.axhline(-270,color="#b2182b",ls="--",lw=1.2)
b.text(3.4,-272,"E. coli Trx1, −270 mV:\nabout as negative as a\nprotein dithiol couple gets",fontsize=7,color="#b2182b",ha="right",va="top")
b.set_xticks(xs); b.set_xticklabels(["50%","10%","1%","0.1%"],fontsize=9)
b.set_xlabel("fraction of AcrIIC1 that would be disulphide-linked")
b.set_ylabel("required midpoint E°' (mV)")
b.invert_yaxis(); b.legend(fontsize=7.6,loc="lower right")
b.set_title("B  Midpoint required for a given degree of oxidation",loc="left",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

pd.DataFrame({"Eo_mV":1000*Eo,"pct_ox_at_measured_-314.4":100*fo_meas,
              "pct_ox_at_-260":100*fo_lo,"pct_ox_at_-200":100*fo_hi}).to_csv("acrIIC1_switch_thermodynamics.csv",index=False)
print("\nNote: C17-C80 is an INTERchain disulphide, so dimerisation entropy adds a further")
print("concentration-dependent penalty beyond this intramolecular equilibrium; the curves are an upper bound on oxidation.")
